strings.title: Foundry Tracker · Armory
strings.tagline: Pick an emblem to review its weapons and push toward your next achievement.
strings.rule: {goal} kills with each of 8 different weapon IDs.
strings.next_done: You already completed this achievement. Feel free to keep checking the other weapons.
strings.next_none: Pick a pending weapon to start its progress.
strings.next_wait: Wait for the read to finish to see your weapons.
strings.no_data: This collection is not in the last read.
strings.path: Shortest path: {kills} kills with the {count} weapons marked in gold.
strings.path_unknown: Shortest path: {kills} kills with the {count} weapons marked in gold ({unknown} of them have no record yet and count as {goal}).
strings.path_impossible: There are not enough weapons left in this collection to complete it.
strings.session_started: Session started. Play, go back to the menu and refresh to see what you gained.
strings.needs_update: Destiny Rising was updated (build {build}). This version of Foundry Tracker supports build {supported}. Download the latest Foundry Tracker to keep reading your progress.
strings.needs_update_engine: Destiny Rising was updated and this version of Foundry Tracker can no longer read it. Download the latest Foundry Tracker.
strings.footer: Read-only · No record is not a measured zero · Extra copies of the same ID do not count as different weapons.
strings.notice_body: Foundry Tracker reads your progress from Destiny Rising Global running in MuMu Player. It needs root access in MuMu to do it:
strings.notice_steps:
1.  Open MuMu Player and go to Settings center → Other.
2.  Turn on Root permission.
3.  Restart MuMu and load your character in the game.

Several game sessions are open. Keep only the one you want to check.
